en.bdb: Stupid is not friendly to truth

verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਨ੍ਹਾ ਆਖੇ ਲੜਿ ਮਰੈ ਖੁਸੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਨਾਉ ਸੁਜਾਖਾ।
verses.translit_en: a(n)nhaa aakhe laR marai khusee hovai sun naau sujaakhaa|

en.bdb: The blind stupid one fights to the finish if he is called blind (intellectually) and feels flattered if called eyed (a wise one).

verses.gurmukhi: ਭੋਲਾ ਆਖੇ ਭਲਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਅਹਮਕੁ ਜਾਣਿ ਅਜਾਣਿ ਨ ਭਾਖਾ।
verses.translit_en: bholaa aakhe bhalaa ma(n)n ahamak jaan ajaan na bhaakhaa|

en.bdb: Calling him simple minded makes him feel good but he would not talk to one who tells him that he is a silly person.

verses.gurmukhi: ਧੋਰੀ ਆਖੈ ਹਸਿ ਦੇ ਬਲਦ ਵਖਾਣਿ ਕਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਖਾ।
verses.translit_en: dhoree aakhai has dhe baladh vakhaan karai man maakhaa|

en.bdb: He smiles at being called a carrier of the burden (of all) but feels angry when told that he is just an ox.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਉਂ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਖਾਇ ਨ ਭਾਖ ਸੁਭਾਖਾ।
verses.translit_en: kaau(n) siaanap jaanadhaa visaTaa khai na bhaakh subhaakhaa|

en.bdb: The crow knows many skills but it crows jarringly and eats faeces.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਸੁਰੀਤ ਕੁਰੀਤ ਦਾ ਮੁਸਕ ਬਿਲਾਈ ਗਾਂਡੀ ਸਾਖਾ।
verses.translit_en: naau sureet kureet dhaa musak bilaiee gaa(n)ddee saakhaa|

en.bdb: To the bad customs the stupid refers as good conduct and calls the indurated faeces of cat, fragrant.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੇਠਿ ਖੜਾ ਥੂ ਥੂ ਕਰੈ ਗਿਦੜ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਦਾਖਾ।
verses.translit_en: heTh khaRaa thoo thoo karai gidhaR hath na aavai dhaakhaa|

en.bdb: As the jackal unable to reach and eat grapes on tree, spits over them, so is the case of a fool.
The foolish person is a blind follower like sheep and his obdurate talk spoils his relationship with every one.
